compositions.comment: Composition is COMPLETE — the kernel ships with NO bundled or transitive direct runtime dependencies. The kernel comprises Markdown agent/skill definitions, JSON Schema state contracts, and Bash verification scripts. Tooling such as `gitleaks` (security scan), `syft` (SBOM generation, future), `jq` (script utility), and `sqlite3` (audit.db reader, optional) are OPERATOR-PROVIDED environment dependencies, not bundled with the kernel.

properties.name: cyclonedx:cisa:minimum-elements:dependency-relationship
properties.value: none — root component has zero dependencies

properties.name: conductor-kernel:sbom-generation-method
properties.value: manual-author (Syft unavailable at Phase 8); MUST be re-generated by Syft at v0.2.0 SDK-bindings release per OH-3

properties.name: conductor-kernel:sbom-verified-by
properties.value: scripts/verify-agent-tools.sh + manual file enumeration; install commands: brew install syft OR curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anchore/syft/main/install.sh | sh
